$comment: Machine form of SPEC_UV_COORDINATES.md. A converter reads this instead of the prose; a reviewer checks the prose against it. Source entries carry only conversions that were measured against real files — a frame nobody has verified is absent from this list rather than guessed at, because a plausible-looking basis is indistinguishable from a measured one once it is written down.

abi.note: the fields already existed and adapters already filled them correctly; this form fixes which combination is canonical and what a conversion must do

canonical.rationale: glTF is the model substrate; agreeing with it removes a conversion from the common path

basis.metersPerUnit: derived from the game's documented cell size

impliedByGrid.note: a value computed because the source did not state it is not the same fact as a value converted from one that did

gridRelationshipWithoutPhysicalScale.rule: grid-implied is an evidence situation, not a ProjectionBasis.unit value; metersPerUnit stays absent until a physical scale is documented

basis.sourceUnit: the source's own unit name, verbatim

absent.rule: no metre factor is invented; a consumer needing physical scale asks the project, not the artifact

conversionRules.handednessBySign: negating exactly one axis flips handedness and leaves the other two meanings intact; a swap also flips it but silently renames up or forward
conversionRules.swapsRestateHandedness: where a Z-up source genuinely requires a swap, the entry states the swap and restates the resulting handedness
conversionRules.scaleIsScalar: one scalar, applied after orientation; non-uniform scale belongs to a node transform, not to a frame
conversionRules.boundsFromCorners: an axis-aligned bound is recomputed from the converted corner set, never by converting min and max individually
conversionRules.emptyHasNoBounds: an empty subject has no bounds; it does not have a zero-volume box at the origin

sources.label: StarCraft II map-native terrain
sources.unitsPerCell: t3Terrain heightMap.scale.x when it exactly equals heightMap.scale.y; otherwise the scalar-cell-size UVW profile refuses materialization
sources.origin: heightfield origin = (offset.x, 0, -(offset.y + (rows - 1) * scale.y)); source rows are reversed so serialized rows advance along canonical +Z

sources.label: Spring S3O
sources.note: 1 elmo = 1/8 map square; the metre factor comes from the map's squareSize, so a standalone model records sourceUnit rather than guessing

sources.label: Unreal Engine
sources.map: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y) then negate x

unmeasured.note: these formats are converted by shipped adapters but their frame is not stated in the conversion spec, so no entry is published here. Adding one means measuring it against a real file, not reading it off another engine that looks similar.
